title: Finite-level representative evaluation for the target tensor presentation
statement: Fix l, E, Y and n and a finite-coefficient closed tensor structure S with coefficient tensor models T and a tensor-Hom adjunction adj. For every K-flat representative pair P,S' and K-injective I, and every chain map q from S' to the internal-Hom complex from P to I, there is a chain map beta from the total tensor of P and S' to I whose sectionwise signed evaluation formula holds and whose derived image is exactly the counit of adj applied to q after the tensor comparison isomorphism.

source.place: paragraph 2, coefficient extension; representative evaluation normalization

proof.text: Choose K-flat representatives and a K-injective target. Define beta by the total-complex evaluation formula with the Koszul sign, verify it is a chain map, and identify its derived image with the adjunction counit using the normalized representative comparison.

theorem finite_tensor_presentation_evaluation :
    ∀ (P I S' : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y
      (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)) ℤ)
      (hP : flat.{t, u} Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P)
      (hS : flat.{t, u} Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) S'),
      I.IsKInjective →
      ∀ q : S' ⟶ homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
        (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P I,
      ∃ beta : ((totalTensor.{t, u} Y
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)).obj P).obj S' ⟶ I,
        (∀ (i j : ℤ) (U : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt Y)ᵒᵖ)
          (x : (P.X i).val.obj U) (s : (S'.X j).val.obj U),
          (beta.f (i + j)).val.app U
              (totalPair.{t, u} Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)
                P S' i j U x s) =
            (i * j).negOnePow • evaluate.{t, u} Y
              (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P I j i U
              ((q.f j).val.app U s) x) ∧
        T.comparison.inv.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨S', hS⟩) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map beta =
          S.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
            (DerivedCategory.Q.map q ≫
              homModelMap.{t, u} Y
                (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P I)) ≫
          (adj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).counit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
